text:
From: michael.thompson@example.com
To: support@example.com
Subject: Cannot reach the staging endpoint

Hi team,

Since this morning our staging environment at 203.0.113.42 has been
unreachable from our office network. We also see the same timeout
from our IPv6-only test host at 2001:db8::1f3. Nothing changed on our
side, so I suspect something on your end.

Can someone take a look? You can reach me directly at (206) 555-0142
if it's faster than email.

Thanks,
Michael Thompson

---

From: Alex Rivera, Support Engineer, Example Cloud Services Inc.
To: michael.thompson@example.com

Hi Michael,

Thanks for the report -- we can confirm a routing issue affecting
203.0.113.42 and have applied a fix. As a goodwill gesture we have
issued a refund of $29.99 for last month's overage charge to the card
on file. Let us know if the issue persists.

Best,
Alex Rivera
